2026_01_DAL_NYG.headline: Dallas’ passing weapons meet New York’s new pressure identity
2026_01_DAL_NYG.paragraph1: Dallas enters the NFC East opener with Dak Prescott throwing to CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens, but the Cowboys will be without starting left guard Tyler Smith. New York begins the John Harbaugh era with Jaxson Dart at quarterback and uncertainty around Malik Nabers as he returns from a torn ACL. The Giants’ front must exploit Dallas’ interior protection issue before Prescott can attack isolated coverage. New York, meanwhile, needs enough explosive offense to avoid asking its defense to survive long stretches against Dallas’ receiver talent.
2026_01_DAL_NYG.model_rationale: Dallas has the more established passing-game ceiling, but New York can tilt the matchup by disrupting interior protection and keeping its own offense out of obvious passing situations.
